verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for desktop software like Parsec, but the evidence pack never mentions telemetry, analytics, or usage-tracking controls. The 'Privacy mode' line on the pricing page and the claim that connections are peer-to-peer are related privacy features, not a documented way to turn off telemetry, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
